summary: Sestakov sqrt(omega(g)) + b*loglogN nález je z veľkej časti artefakt zlej baseline. Voči peer-reviewed Wolf 2014 PRE eq. (7) amplitúda omega-člena klesá o 78% (M1*) až 95% (M3); loglog N člen je plne absorbovaný do publikovaného Wolf finite-size driftu; OOS R^2 voči Wolf2014 je -18.3 (horšie než priemer).

wolf_drift_reproduction.shape: monotonically decreasing, same as Wolf Fig. 6
wolf_drift_reproduction.absolute_offset: ~0.15 lower than Wolf (likely u_max=2 vs Wolf's range)

loglogN_explained_by_wolf_drift.conclusion: Wolf's published finite-size drift in (a, s) reproduces ~100% of Sestak's b*loglogN term

answers_to_three_questions.Q1_omega_survives_vs_Wolf2014: NIE — amplitúda klesá z 0.836 na 0.184 (M1*) a na 0.026 (M3). M3 hodnota je v rámci šumu od nuly.
answers_to_three_questions.Q2_loglogN_reproduces_wolf_drift: ÁNO — slope_a + slope_s vs loglogN dáva 1.01x Sestakov b koeficient. Plná numerická zhoda.
answers_to_three_questions.Q3_OOS_R2_vs_Wolf2014: -18.27 — model úplne nefunguje na hold-out N > 1e13 voči Wolf2014 baseline.
